_doc: Opening phrases rewritten by rule weak_phrase. Each maps to a template; {rest} is the original remainder. 'gerund_to_verb' means: if the remainder starts with a known gerund, use that verb (tense from the entry); otherwise leave the bullet unchanged. 'gerund_or_contribute' ("worked on" only): a following known gerund becomes that verb ("Worked on building X" → "Built X"), otherwise "Contributed to {rest}". "Helped with" / "assisted with" always become "Contributed to" so a supporting role is never turned into sole credit.
